rows.question: What is the termination notice period?

rows.question: Can I end the contract early?

rows.question: What happens if the other party breaches the agreement?
rows.answer: Clause 8.2 (page 2) says: “Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to remedy it within 10 days of being notified.”

rows.question: How much is the monthly fee?
rows.answer: Clause 4.1 (page 1) says: “The Client shall pay the Provider a fixed monthly fee of INR 1,80,000, exclusive of applicable taxes.”

rows.question: When are invoices due?
rows.answer: Clause 4.2 (page 1) says: “The Provider shall invoice monthly in arrears. Each invoice is payable within 15 days of receipt.”

rows.question: What interest applies to late payments?
rows.answer: Clause 4.3 (page 1) says: “Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month on the overdue amount until paid in full.”

rows.question: How long is the initial term?
rows.answer: Clause 3.1 (page 1) says: “This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months.”

rows.question: Does the agreement renew automatically?
rows.answer: Clause 3.2 (page 1) says: “After the initial term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive periods of twelve (12) months unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current term.”

rows.question: How long do confidentiality obligations last?
rows.answer: Clause 5.2 (page 2) says: “The obligations in this Section 5 survive for three (3) years after this Agreement ends.”

rows.question: Who owns the deliverables?
rows.answer: Clause 6.1 (page 2) says: “Upon full payment, all rights in the Deliverables are assigned to the Client. The Provider retains ownership of its pre-existing tools and know-how.”

rows.question: Is there a cap on liability?
rows.answer: Clause 7.2 (page 2) says: “Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months before the claim arose.”

rows.question: Which law governs this agreement?
rows.answer: Clause 9.1 (page 2) says: “This Agreement is governed by the laws of India.”

rows.question: Where would disputes be resolved?
rows.answer: Clause 9.2 (page 2) says: “The parties shall first try to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation for 30 days. Unresolved disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Bengaluru.”

rows.question: Can the agreement be assigned to someone else?
rows.answer: Clause 10.2 (page 2) says: “Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent.”

rows.question: How often must the provider send performance reports?
rows.answer: Clause 2.2 (page 1) says: “The Provider shall deliver a monthly performance report to the Client within five business days after the end of each calendar month.”
